name: Dadabhai & Sons
description:
Founded in 1904 by Mr. Mohamed Ali Dadabhai,
We are More Than A Century Old Establishment Which is Now Run By The Fourth Generation Of The Family.
Started initially as Wooden Furniture’s Antique Dealers, we Diversify into Movie and Advertisement Set Props Suppliers In The 1960s And Are Credited with Setting up Scenes of Popular Bollywood Classics Like Jaanbaaz and Qurbaani.
Art directors use to Spend Hours at our Warehouse, Handpicking art Object and Furniture to Shoot a Particular Scene. Since 2004 we have Transformed into Dealers of Industrial & Art Deco Antiques.
Browse Through our Extensive Collection of Industrial /Art Deco - Furniture / Lamps / Floor & Table Fans, Decorative Items / Statues & other Miscellaneous Collectable items.

The shop's knowledgeable staff is always on hand to provide insights into the history and provenance of their pieces. Their passion for antiques is evident in their enthusiasm and expertise.
Whether you're a seasoned collector or simply looking for a unique piece to add to your home, this antique shop is a must-visit. It's a place where you can discover the beauty and charm of the past.

Situated in Abdul Rehman Street this place is a bit difficult to find due to it's location. Also, it's located on the first floor.

Honestly, this place is like being in heaven for artists and art lovers alike. It has got all possible brands and all possible things that an artist needs and wants. The only problem that I found is that it is way too expensive.

Situated in Abdul Rehman, you would get the same products at the lowest price possible in nearby shops. No doubt that the brands you get here are quite difficult to find nearby but, if you are not really a brand specific shopper I would suggest you to walk down the street and you will get the exact same product at dirt cheap prices.

Also a thing that was a bit off-putting was the service provided. It felt like the staff was forced to help and showed the least amount of interest.

featured_reviews.name: anjitha mekkayil anand
featured_reviews.review_text:
Phillips Antiques, nestled in the heart of Mumbai's heritage district near Colaba, is more than just a shop; it's a living museum steeped in history. Established in 1860, this family-owned establishment is one of the oldest antique stores in the city, and stepping inside feels like a journey back in time.
The carefully curated collection is a treasure trove of colonial-era finds and exquisite pieces from across Asia. From magnificent carved wooden furniture – beds, armchairs, settees, and marble-topped tables – to delicate Victorian curios, gilded mirrors, and religious statues, every item tells a story. You'll find a fascinating array of lamps, lithographs, old maps, and photographs of pre-Independence Bombay, offering a nostalgic glimpse into the city's past.
The true charm of Phillips Antiques lies not just in its impressive inventory, but also in the passion and knowledge of its proprietors. They are more like curators, happy to share the provenance and significance of each piece, making the Browse experience educational and truly captivating. While the prices reflect the rarity and quality of the items, even if you're not in the market to buy, a visit to Phillips Antiques is a must for anyone with an appreciation for history, art, and the unique allure of old-world charm in modern Mumbai.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Chor Bazar is famous and bustling flea market located in Mumbai, India. It is situated in the South Mumbai neighborhood of Bhendi Bazaar, near Mohammed Ali Road.

Chor Bazar has a long history and is known for its diverse range of goods, including antiques, electronics, vintage items, clothing, furniture, and much more.

We visited Chor Bazaar for a photowalk and the vendors were kind enough to let us click pictures and cooperated really well.

Chor Bazar is famous for its collection of goods. It's a treasure trove for antique lovers, offering vintage furniture, old coins, vintage watches, gramophones, vintage cameras, and other unique collectibles.

Exploring Chor Bazar offers a glimpse into the vibrant street culture of Mumbai. The market is often crowded, and the narrow lanes are filled with shops and stalls. The lively atmosphere, bustling crowd, and the vendors' enthusiastic salesmanship create a unique and immersive experience.

Chor Bazar is a must-visit destination for shoppers, collectors, and those looking for unique items with a touch of nostalgia. Its rich history, vibrant atmosphere, and the opportunity to discover hidden treasures make it an exciting and popular place to explore in Mumbai.

One of the most unique experiences you can have in your lifetime.

name: Artequest Art Gallery
description:
Artequest Art Gallery (AAG) the famous art gallery in South Asia has established in 2010 at prime location in Mumbai, India. It has grown with a view to promote Modern Art and Contemporary Art. The gallery relentlessly involved in the recognition and promotion of emerging Artists, creating an awareness of art amongst old and new collectors by showcasing good quality art works and providing a platform for interaction between artists and Art collectors.

Artequest goes through a rigorous selection process and bringing only authentic & original paintings for sale. Our Collection includes Tyeb Mehta, Jamini Roy, S.H Raza, F.N.Souza, M. F. Husain, Laxma Goud, ThotaVaikuntam, Anjolie Ela Menon and so many more well-known & young artists.

featured_reviews.name: Philip Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
In the ‘Maximum City’ of Mumbai, Artequest gallery offers a unique experience of serene beauty of art. It boasts of amazing collection of both ‘Masters’ and other renowned artists spanning the length and breadth of our country.

It has wide range of paintings, sculptors, lithographs, sketches and drawings. Mumbai has many renowned art galleries and Artequest shines as one of the ‘must see’ galleries in the city.
Artequest had displayed its works in many countries across the globe and attracted many international connoisseurs of art.

The gallery offers serene ambience where one can immerse in artistic poetry. Its location is easy to find on google maps, and it has ample parking space too.  It’s not to be missed if you are living in Mumbai or travelling to this wonderful city.
